subject.title: Feature: notify sender on WhatsApp after pairing approval

question: Should the remaining WhatsApp approval-notification work be implemented as the existing optional `--notify` behavior, and which gateway/plugin SDK delivery seam should own it?
rationale: The user problem is source-reproducible, but the previous direct PRs were closed unmerged after raising SDK-shape and live-proof concerns, and default notification/replay would expand the product contract beyond the current CLI flag.

options.title: Approve narrow `--notify` repair
options.body: Implement WhatsApp approval notification only when the existing `--notify` option is used, require live/gateway proof, and avoid default-on or replay behavior in this issue.

options.title: Design broader approval UX
options.body: Use this issue to decide default notification, configurable message text, and blocked-message replay semantics before code changes.

options.title: Defer until SDK seam is settled
options.body: Keep the issue open but do not queue another implementation until maintainers choose the plugin-facing delivery API shape.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow `--notify` repair
recommendation.body: Implement WhatsApp approval notification only when the existing `--notify` option is used, require live/gateway proof, and avoid default-on or replay behavior in this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest combined history across the pairing facade, plugin SDK shape, outbound delivery policy, and WhatsApp channel-adjacent routing.
